'''Sherris''' was an infamous [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]].<ref name="Key to Nowhere">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Key to Nowhere}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Sherris was mentioned in an Investigation Crew Skill mission of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[BioWare]], though the information regarding the mission's outcome, which contained the only mentions of the character, was later removed from the game.<ref name="Key to Nowhere" />
